description: Use when comparing activity across venues. `source_sync` gives listing clocks even without summary figures. Totals scope is gemini, kalshi, limitless, manifold, myriad, opinion, polymarket, predict. `grand_total_volume_24hr` sums measured real-money totals and omits dated exclusions. See `missing_volume_sources` and `unavailable_sources`. Volume is in US dollars (notional: one share or contract pays $1) except on Manifold, which uses play-money mana.
name: get_summary
title: Per-platform summary
